shortDescription: SPECIAL BTA CONTRACT: An Overlord-class DropShip is undergoing emergency repairs and must remain protected until its engines are ready for launch. Enemy forces are closing on your position; hold the perimeter, prevent them from disrupting the launch sequence, and buy the ship enough time to escape. THIS CONTRACT IS QUITE DIFFICULT, AND EXTREMELY LONG, COME PREPARED FOR EXTENDED COMBAT DO NOT BRING TANKS TO THIS MISSION, TANKS CAN BUG OUT ON CONTRACT COMPLETION AND YOU CAN LOSE THEM PERMANENTLY. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.

dialogueContent.words: The DropShip is still coming online, many of its weapon system are inoperable.  Your priority is to hold the perimeter and keep the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} away from the ship until we can lift.

Expect multiple waves; concentrate fire, plug the gaps, and do not let anything reach the landing pad.

If we lose the dropship, we fail the mission.
The DropShip has cleared the perimeter and is safely away.  Enemy forces have been repelled, the launch sequence completed, and our evacuation was successful.  Mission accomplished.
We couldn't recover everything before the emergency launch, but Command has authorized additional compensation to make up for the lost salvage.  Consider it hazard pay --- you earned every credit.
The ship is lost, and the mission has failed.

Contact!  First hostile lance closing fast.  Looks like they're making straight for the DropShip.  Engines aren't ready yet, so hold your positions and keep them away.  This is only the beginning, Commander.

More hostile contacts incoming, moving in behind the first wave.  Looks like they're testing our defenses --- or trying to pin us down.

Stay focused, hold the perimeter, and keep the DropShip protected.
More opfors inbound and they're coming in hard.  They're committed to breaking through our perimeter; concentrate fire and don't give them an opening; we've got a long fight ahead of us.
Additional foes inbound!  They're coming in fast.  We're seeing heavier signatures this time, looks like they're escalating.

Wait, another lance just entered the combat zone!  Damn it...they're coming in pairs now.

Let's hope that was a one-time trick.

They may be trying to flank and moving directly toward the DropShip.  We're being surrounded!  Shift your fire and close that gap before they reach the dropship's perimeter!

Two more grouped hostile blips on the ground!

So much for hoping. They're deploying in pairs to overwhelm us.
Stay focused, Commander.
Another hostile lance appears.  We thought we'd bought ourselves some breathing room, but their command clearly has other plans.  Weapons free: destroy them before they can close on the DropShip!

Another lance of enemies just entered the field.  The last one's barely cold, and they're already sending in the next wave.

No time to rest, keep them off the DropShip and destroy them before they can regroup!
Another contact!  More hostile lance have just been deployed.  We've destroyed everything they've thrown at us, and they still keep coming.
New contacts!

Another lance just deployed alongside the previous one.  Two more lances at once --- again.

Whatever they're throwing at us, we're destroying it.  Keep the DropShip standing.
They're not giving us a moment to breathe.  Keep your weapons hot and hold the perimeter.
We've made it this far and yet they keep sending more...stay sharp.
We've had the previous wave barely off our scopes, and they're already sending another.  We're deep into the final stretch now; keep the pressure on.
CONTACTS EVERYWHERE!  Five enemy lances just dropped simultaneously!  That's their entire remaining force, and they're making one final push for the DropShip.
We've held this line against everything they've thrown at us...now finish the job!  Protect that ship at all costs.  This is it!

Engines are online!  The DropShip is cleared for launch.  We've held the line wth the time we were given, hostiles are still in the area, but they no longer matter.
We only need one unit to the rally point --- however, if the DropShip is destroyed before launch, we fail.  Protect that ship until the very last second!
Splash one lance. Tell their employer to send better pilots.
That's one lance off the payroll. Who's next?
Another lance just paid the price.
Dialogue_Killed_Target_Lance_06
One more lance reduced to salvage. Keep them coming.
Overlord's still standing.  Enemy lance is nothing but smoking wrecks.

Almost a regiment's worth of units...confirmed destroyed.  I don't know what they thought they were facing, but they clearly underestimated you.

The perimeter is secure, the DropShip is safe, and against all expectations, we're still standing.  Outstanding work.
